scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.tunnel: concurrently -n client,server,tunnel -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "cloudflared tunnel --url localhost:5173"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.cleanup: cmd /c "(FOR /F "tokens=5" %a IN ('netstat -ano ^| findstr ":3006 :5173" ^| findstr LISTENING') DO taskkill /PID %a /F) 2>nul || echo Ports 3006 and 5173 are already free"
